Subject: Discovery recap & next steps — Privly / Redwood

Hi Alyssa / Tom,

Great to meet earlier today — thank you for walking through your infra and the 3 use-cases you highlighted (in-product search, knowledge base summaries, and automated support routing). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary notes:
- Current infra: Kubernetes on AWS (EKS) with existing caching layer; estimated peak concurrency ~120 qps for the KB-sync job.
- Security: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS is a must; you pointed to compliance window in Q2.
- Goals: reduce per-interaction cost by >=40% vs current hosted model and keep 95th latency under 300ms for short-chat flows.

Action items / proposed timeline:
1) Technical deep-dive: Karthik + your infra engineer to run through model sizing and token profiles (30–45m) — target week of Mar 8.
2) Pilot scope: we suggested a 4-week pilot (dedicated capacity) for the KB use-case; I'll send a draft pricing proposal.
3) Compliance: Monica to share SOC2 evidence and KMS integration notes.

Please confirm: is week of Mar 8 feasible for a 30–45m technical session? If not, share alternative windows and any additional stakeholders you want on the call (procurement / security).

I attached a short PDF with my discovery notes and the three scenarios we discussed.

Thanks,
Sean

Hi Alyssa —

I haven’t heard back after the pricing draft and the pilot-credit note, so I wanted to check in one last time. If Privly’s priority has shifted or this isn’t the right time, say the word and I’ll close the file on our side — we can always reopen when timing is better.

If you’re still interested: great — tell me which tech-session window from my earlier note works and I’ll send invites. If you’d like a different owner on our side to stay in touch, I’m happy to introduce.

If I don’t hear anything by Fri, Mar 12 I’ll assume this is a low priority and close the active opportunity; I’ll leave a note on the account in our CRM but we can reopen anytime.

Appreciate the time you and Tom spent on the discovery call — thanks again.
